verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs describe deploying via `flyctl`/`fly launch` (implying Docker/Dockerfile-based builds) and a dedicated CLI docs page, but the evidence pack lacks explicit first-party documentation of Docker image/Dockerfile support. Multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict a smooth deploy workflow, citing container pushes failing 70-80% of the time with no useful errors, and deploys leading to stuck/unreachable instances. missing for 10: explicit first-party Dockerfile/Docker-image deployment docs, independent corroboration of successful container deploys, resolution of the cited deploy-failure reports.
